items.html: The difference, however, is this: there, in Hochma, which is the drop of male waters descending from above downward, therefore the two supernal [names] Yud-Hey-Vav descended and were included in the lower Yud-Hey-Vav. But here, in Bina, which is the drop of female waters rising from below upward, it is the reverse — for the four middle and lower [names of] Ehyeh are included in the two supernal [names of] Ehyeh of the Yuds, which likewise equal 42.
